What is a Dinner Decider?

A Dinner Decider is your answer to the eternal question: "What's for dinner?" With 100+ dishes across 10 cuisine categories, plus the ability to add your own favorites, it takes the stress out of meal planning. Whether you're in the mood for Italian, Asian, Mexican, or just need inspiration, we've got delicious options waiting.

When to Use the Dinner Decider

  • • Daily meal planning when you can't decide
  • • Trying new cuisines or restaurants
  • • Family dinner discussions where everyone's indecisive
  • • Meal prep inspiration for the week
  • • Late-night snack decisions

Pros

  • ✓ 10 cuisine categories with 100+ dishes
  • ✓ Add custom dishes to the mix
  • ✓ Browse categories to explore cuisines
  • ✓ Perfect for restaurant planning too
  • ✓ Takes the stress out of meal decisions

Considerations

  • • Results may not match your dietary needs
  • • Consider what's in your fridge/pantry
  • • Factor in cooking time and skill level
  • • Budget may influence final choice

Frequently Asked Questions

What cuisines are available?

We have Italian, Asian, Mexican, American, Healthy, Japanese, Comfort Food, Vegetarian, Mediterranean, and Desserts. Select multiple cuisines to mix them all together!

Can I add my own dishes?

Yes! Use the "Add Custom Options" section to type in any dish you like. Your custom dishes will be included alongside our built-in options for a truly personalized decision.

How does the randomization work?

The tool randomly selects from all dishes in your selected categories (plus any custom dishes). Each dish has an equal chance of being selected.

Let deliciousness guide your evening

Use the Dinner Decider to Teach Compromise and Exploration

The Dinner Decider is perfect for family meal planning. Let kids pick their favorite cuisine category, discuss what sounds good, and let the tool decide. This removes the "we can't agree" argument and teaches that sometimes letting chance choose is a valid way to solve disagreements. It also introduces kids to new cuisines they might not have tried otherwise.
